question: Which of the following correctly expresses the relationship between power, force, time and distance?
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Understanding the Relationship Between Power, Force, Time, and Distance**

To understand the relationship between power, force, time, and distance, we must first comprehend the fundamental definitions and formulas related to these physical quantities.

Power (P) is the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred over time. Force (F) is any interaction that, when unopposed, will change the motion of an object.
